snippet.title: No One to See - Pinebark Camp | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
In Pinebark, the silence is listening.
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4175050/No_One_to_See_Pinebark_Camp/

Going through a hard time, Ethan went camping alone in the Pinebark woods. He wanted a few days away from everything, and a little silence. He only stayed two days. When he came back, he was no longer the same.

No One to See is a short first-person psychological horror game with a VHS look. You relive those two days the way he tells them.

🎙️ At certain moments, the game listens to your microphone. Talking, shouting, moving: nothing goes unnoticed out there.
🏕️ Drive to the woods, set up camp, light the campfire, cook and fish at the lake.
💬 Talk to the people you meet along the way and choose your replies.
📼 A short, complete story you can finish in 40 to 50 minutes.

Best played with headphones and a microphone.

Coming soon to PC on Steam. Add it to your wishlist to get notified when it launches.
